statements.t: Management’s plans to address the Company’s liquidity requirements include increasing revenues through its dental and medical businesses, expanding domestic and international distribution opportunities, managing operating expenses, improving working capital efficiency, and pursuing additional financing opportunities, if necessary.
Management believes that existing cash resources, anticipated customer collections, and continued expense management measures will support near-term operating activities.
However, the Company expects that additional financing will be required to fund its anticipated operating requirements over the assessment period.
